head: d2f0d1e5446c26ca56cf611f91e9264aabf9e19b
protocol: 20/100/500 torrents, 100 samples, 1/4/8 concurrency, two five-repeat C before/after series and five rotated A/B/C. Largest 500/8 cell also sampled cgroup anon/file/total separately on the same frozen snapshots.
source_overlay_note: Explicit snapshots override generic raw labels; B uses archived main. The first memory post attempt had a bad source path and is excluded; corrected source was rerun.
decision: PASS: identical C payload hashes and zero errors in all nine cells; p95 and CPU improve beyond J in both post series; RSS meets the side-effect gate. The 20-torrent RSS reduction is within J, so no significant RSS gain is claimed there. Largest-cell separate anon/file measurements demonstrate heap reduction, with no production throughput claim.
